name: MsoFeatureInstall
description: Specifies how the application handles calls to methods and properties that require features not yet installed.

constants.name: msoFeatureInstallNone
constants.description: Generates a generic automation error at run time when uninstalled features are called.

constants.name: msoFeatureInstallOnDemand
constants.description: Prompts the user to install new features.

constants.name: msoFeatureInstallOnDemandWithUI
constants.description: Displays a progress meter during installation; does not prompt the user to install new features.
